en: Jesus shall take the highest honor
Jesus shall take the highest praise

ko: 모든 이름 위에 뛰어난 그 이름
en: Let all earth join heaven in exalting
The Name which is above all other names
Let's bow the knee, in humble adoration
For at His name, every knee must bow
Let every tongue confess He is Christ,
God's only Son Sovereign Lord, we give You glory now
For all honour and blessing and power belongs to You Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God
